svg.text: Figure 1: Solution Architecture Diagram (C4 Container View)
Cloud-Native, Real-Time Financial Fraud Detection Platform (Peak: 1,000 TPS | Latency P99 < 45ms)
Cloud-Native Microservices Mesh (Kubernetes EKS / GKE + Istio Service Mesh)
Event Backbone: Apache Kafka Enterprise (32 Partitions / Topic | KRaft Quorum | 3-AZ Replicated)
Dead Letter Queues (DLQ): trans.raw.dlq | trans.enriched.dlq | fraud.eval.dlq (Poison Pill Quarantine)
AWS S3 / GCS Object Lock (7-Yr Retention)
Enterprise Unified Observability, Telemetry & SLO Management Layer (OpenTelemetry Standard)
• PII & PAN Data Masked at Ingress
• Prometheus Exemplars link Metric Spike -> Trace ID
• Single Click Jump: Trace Waterfall -> Microservice Logs
